Travel 1 tile to meadow.
— Open ground —
Grasshoppers rise in a clicking wave ahead of you. Something fork-tailed rides the wind above them, waiting for the careless ones.
Movement — a waddling stripe of black and white, tail up like it's making a point.
👁 It is not afraid of you. It has exactly one argument and it wins every argument. Trap it at dusk holding a tarp low — or just don't.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 11 people, 5 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — Fernando telling Ava about themself. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
A woodpecker works somewhere you can't see. Down here it smells of mushrooms and cold shade.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Old growth. The canopy closes overhead and the light comes down in shafts. Something rustled, and decided not to be seen.
Movement — a waddling porcupine, quills rattling softly.
👁 Never grab it barehanded. A bow works clean; hands get quills. Flip it with a long stick if you must.

Saplings push up through last year's deadfall, racing each other for the light. The forest never stops trying.
